title: Ibm Security Advisories - 2026-07-10
description:
Merged 2 ibm security advisories published on 2026-07-10. Original advisory IDs: IBM-7279723, IBM-7279724

Titles:
- IBM Application Modernization Accelerator is affected by multiple vulnerabilities found in Java, JavaScript and IBM WebSphere Application Server Liberty
- IBM Transformation Advisor is affected by multiple vulnerabilities found in Java, JavaScript and IBM WebSphere Application Server Liberty
